note_versions_pinned_to_match_1p: gymnasium/ale-py/numpy pinned to the exact versions already used by the 1P lane (src/envcfg.py) for consistency; pettingzoo/its own dependencies resolved by pip against those pins.

system_python_incompatibility.detail: The system python3 on magicSTUDIObox is 3.9.6, which cannot satisfy gymnasium>=1.2.0's Requires-Python>=3.10. Used the already-installed Homebrew python3.12 instead (python3.14 was also available but 3.12 was chosen for broader wheel availability).

import_state.note: Only the module and its parallel_env/raw_env attributes were inspected; no environment was constructed, which would require the ROM.

claim_ceiling: Dependency installability and module import are verified. This does not authorize or imply ROM acquisition, environment construction, or gameplay execution.
